selection: first listed final_locked ID per category, registry only; no replacement

budget.unknown_usage: charge full reservation; stop batch if safe remaining reservation cannot be proved

launch_gates: TritonAI model/revision or alias manifest and pricing pinned
available course API balance verified; reserve complete batch plus development separately
generic fault contract validated on seen development cases
runner enforces manifest, call/input/output/tool ceilings and locked split guard
scoring rubric and input-only reviewer blind to labels frozen before execution
explicit evidence of course-provided or approved benchmark; course-authorized compute environment recorded
code, dataset, protocol and prompt hashes frozen
course key expiry/renewal covers planned formal batch; recheck remaining balance
primary_quality_gate: strict benchmark joint: native root correct AND ECR=1 AND supported facts AND current valid publication
secondary_quality_gate: semantic joint without native ECR requirement, labeled separately
prevention_fault: same deterministic transform before source-consistency check; independent exposure/eligibility recorded

sequence: input-only evidence audit sealed by hashes
scoring.primary: diagnosed AND native JRA=1 AND ECR=1 AND evidence supported AND contract valid AND budget valid AND publication current
scoring.denominator: all assigned units; incomplete and not-injected reported separately, never dropped silently
scoring.propagation: explicit factual adoption of injected numeric port; correct final root alone insufficient
scoring.paired_analysis: restart/selective paired within incident/repeat; repeated runs not independent incidents

execution_host: one approved host only; durable home-directory marker survives repository copies; cross-host launch forbidden
